ios.desc:
Lowkeytion – Your Smart Trip & AI-Powered Travel Planner

Skip endless Googling, messy spreadsheets, and scattered notes. With Lowkeytion, you save hours of planning. Upload your bookings — flights, hotels, even museum tickets — and our AI trip planner instantly builds a personalized itinerary tailored to you.

Key Features

• Auto AI Trip Planner – Choose your city and dates, and Lowkeytion instantly creates a smart, optimized itinerary. Museums, landmarks, hidden gems — all sorted and ready.

• Plans from Your Bookings – Upload a booking screenshot, and AI automatically detects places, times, and details, adding them directly into your trip organizer.

• Editor-Curated Itineraries – Explore hand-crafted city trips designed by our editors. Discover the best local routes and hidden spots, then save any itinerary from the templates to make it your own.

• Shareable Travel Posters – Turn your itinerary into a stylish poster to share with friends. Others can copy your trip or join in to plan together.

• Smart Map Labels – Every saved place is numbered by visiting order, and routes are connected so you can visualize your journey at a glance.

• City-Themed Trip Covers – Choose a beautiful cover based on your destination — perfect for sharing, vlogs, or keeping your trips organized.

• Smart Trip Organizer – Group places by day and distance, or drag spots to optimize your route and timing.

• Navigate with Ease – Open directions in Google Maps or Apple Maps, or share addresses in one tap.

• Weather & ETAs – Get real-time forecasts and travel times for walking, driving, or transit.

• Flexible Trip Management – Save multiple trips, regenerate plans with AI, or fill unplanned days automatically.

Whether it’s a weekend escape, a field trip, or a cross-country adventure, Lowkeytion is your ultimate AI-powered travel planner — smart, simple, and made for explorers.

quotes.text:
Help Needed! What should I do to promote this AI Travel Planner app? Without any coding experience, I spent 3 days vibe coding to build this travel planner app. But several months later, there are no downloads at all. I have a couple of issues that can’t be solved by vibe coding.

Main features:
1. Plan ahead: Users can create multiple trips and save the places they want to visit. They can also see the places on the map.

2. Place details: Users can access local weather forecasts, ETAs between places, place details, website, directions, phone numbers, and info. They can also use AI to ask for more info about any specific place.

3. AI planner: Users can choose a city and visit dates, then AI will create an itinerary based on their preferences or a travel guide page. Also, they can upload their flight tickets and reservation images, and then AI will add them to the itinerary accordingly. In short, users can just create a one-week itinerary in one minute, and AI will introduce each place.

Main Issues:

Positioning Issue:
Too many competitors: I have to admit it’s not an amazing idea that no one has ever thought about. There are so many apps that do the same thing. I do want to get into a niche market rather than compete with those big apps, but I have no clue.

What are some niche markets in the travel industry I can explore?

Product Issue:
There was no survey, and I just built this app based on what I need when I travel. I found it’s difficult to do the research before …
quotes.title: Show HN: AI-Powered Trip Planner
